Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: About 30 minutes ago, I suddenly lost vision in my right eye while I was watching TV. It was painless and there hasn’t been any change in my left eye.

“It feels like a sudden dark curtain covered my right eye, and everything looks severely blurred or missing, but I don’t have any pain. My left eye is normal, and this happened all at once about half an hour ago.”

“No, I didn’t notice any flashes of light or new floaters—just the sudden dark curtain over my right eye and then everything became severely blurred or missing all at once.”
